mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, code, approve_status, approve_time, approve_user_id, approve_user_name, invalid_status, invalid_remark, source_id, source_type, source_code, demand_type, shop_id, shop_name, country_id, country_name, delivery_warehouse_id, delivery_warehouse_name, dest_warehouse_id, dest_warehouse_name, remark, fulfillment_center, inventory_org_id, inventory_org_name
mapper.select: select approve_status, count(id) from first_mile_delivery where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

SELECT approve_status AS tabFlag, count(*) AS count FROM first_mile_delivery WHERE is_deleted=FALSE
GROUP BY approve_status

SELECT fd.code AS deliveryCode, CASE WHEN approve_status = 'approve' THEN '已发货' ELSE '未发货' END AS deliveryStatus, CASE WHEN approve_status = 'approve' THEN '已发货' ELSE '未发货' END AS deliveryStatusName, SUM(fdd.delivery_qty) AS deliveryQty, fd.approve_time AS deliveryTime FROM first_mile_delivery fd INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fd.id = fdd.main_id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN first_mile_delivery_logistics fdl ON fd.id = fdl.main_id AND fdl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND fd.source_id IN
#{sourceId}
GROUP BY fd.code, deliveryStatus, fd.approve_time ORDER BY fd.code DESC

SELECT fd.code, fdd.id, fdd.main_id, fdd.sku_id, fdd.sku_no, fd.delivery_warehouse_id AS warehouseId, fd.delivery_warehouse_name AS warehouseName, fdd.warehouse_location, fdd.delivery_qty AS assembleQty FROM first_mile_delivery fd INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fd.id = fdd.main_id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN first_mile_delivery_logistics fdl ON fd.id = fdl.main_id AND fdl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fd.is_deleted = FALSE AND fdd.is_combination = TRUE
AND fd.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY fd.code DESC

SELECT fmcb.box_no, concat(box_length, '*', fmc.box_width, '*', fmc.box_height) AS boxSize, fmc.package_weight, fmcb.box_desc FROM first_mile_delivery fmd INNER JOIN first_mile_carton fmc ON fmc.main_id = fmd.id AND fmc.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN first_mile_carton_detail fmcd ON fmc.id = fmcd.carton_id AND fmcd.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN first_mile_carton_bill fmcb ON fmc.id = fmcb.carton_id AND fmcb.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fmd.is_deleted = FALSE AND fmd.id = #{id}
